2024.levels_note: The GKV has two books: the Gesundheitsfonds (column BAS) collects contributions and the federal grant and allocates them to the insurers; the insurers (column BUND, all Krankenkassen) pay the benefits. Adding the two revenue totals double counts the allocations. `consolidated` eliminates them.
